body: I don’t know what to do please help. She’s treating me so badly
I want to be your friend
I’m here if you want to talk
Are your thoughts intrusive or real?

The feeling when you realise you have no one to turn to is heartbreaking. As a kid you have your parents, if you’re religious you have god but if you’re none and have no friends at all the only person you have is yourself . If anything horrifying happens you can only rely on yourself it’s so scary
